replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have a bit of a love-hate relationship with mathematics. It's not my favorite subject, but I appreciate its logic and problem-solving aspects. I find it challenging, but I also enjoy the sense of accomplishment when I finally understand a concept.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I do get anxious when thinking about complex math problems. My high neuroticism makes me worry about not understanding or solving problems correctly. However, I try to take breaks and seek help when needed.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't used AI specifically for math learning, but I've used online resources and calculators that might use AI. I found them helpful, but I prefer hands-on practice and explanations from teachers.
